svg.title: The Map of the Field, Cardioimmunology
svg.desc: A curated educational atlas by Brahim Abdelouaeb. Six reading families, with the heart at the centre. Geometry and reading links are not causal evidence.

svg.aria-label: Circular constellation of cardioimmunology, with the heart at its centre
svg.style: fill: rgb(0, 0, 0); stroke: none; stroke-width: 1px; stroke-linejoin: miter; stroke-dasharray: none; font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal; text-anchor: start; paint-order: normal; opacity: 1;

title.style: fill: rgb(0, 0, 0); stroke: none; stroke-width: 1px; stroke-linejoin: miter; stroke-dasharray: none; font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal; text-anchor: start; paint-order: normal; opacity: 1;

svg.title: The map of the field

desc.style: fill: rgb(0, 0, 0); stroke: none; stroke-width: 1px; stroke-linejoin: miter; stroke-dasharray: none; font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal; text-anchor: start; paint-order: normal; opacity: 1;

svg.desc: A circular reading map with the heart at its centre. Innate and adaptive immunity cross its six reading families. The geometry and connectors do not assert a causal mechanism. Select a theme to read its question, evidence and selected article.
